rows.text: when `rcx` and its qword `+0x0` are both non-null, rewrites `edx` in sequence from that qword's sign-extended words: -1 becomes word `+0x52`, then a value of -2 becomes word `+0x78`, then a value of -3 becomes word `+0x7A` (each test sees the value the previous step left), then any value still negative becomes word `+0x52`; on every path (a null `rcx` or qword leaves `edx` as given) returns `edx` when it is non-negative and 0 otherwise
